stories.title: Enamed será aplicado neste domingo; veja regras para estudantes de medicina

en.title: Enamed will be administered this Sunday; see rules for medical students
en.summary: Medical students across Brazil will take the Enamed national assessment exam on Sunday, which is mandatory for those completing their degrees and certain fourth-year students meeting criteria set by the education institute.

stories.title: Trens da linha 7-rubi vão funcionar com lentidão neste domingo (13) para retirada árvore dos trilhos

en.title: Line 7-rubi trains will operate slowly on Sunday (13) to remove tree from tracks
en.summary: The ruby line will operate with reduced speed and longer intervals on Sunday to remove a large tree that fell onto the tracks near Pirituba station in northern São Paulo.

stories.title: BRB diz ter sido ‘vítima de atos criminosos’

en.title: BRB says it was 'victim of criminal acts'
en.summary: Banco de Brasília claimed to be a victim of criminal conduct regarding purchases of Master bank portfolios. Seven directors, including the former CEO, allegedly committed fraudulent management across 25 operations totaling 17.5 billion reais.
